blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Typhoon Cempaka is expected to enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) on Monday morning and will get the local name Samuel, but is not expected to directly affect the country’s weather, according to the weather bureau. In its 11 p.m. advisory on Sunday, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Cempaka was maintaining its strength as it moved west-northwestward over the Philippine Sea.
